# Park + notify

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P4 · Agents everywhere](../README.md#phase-4--agents-everywhere) · **Lane:** Worker · **Label:** `feature:park-notify` · **Epic:** [#221](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/221) · **Tickets:** 6 (2S 4M)

When a request needs a user grant or connected account that does not exist yet, the worker can hold it for a short time while the CP notifies the user. If the user completes the flow in time the request continues; otherwise the agent gets the normal JIT 403.

## How we build it

- Per-agent settings `park: {enabled: false, maxWait: 20s (cap 60s), notify: true}` distributed in SettingsWire; worker-wide `park.maxConcurrent` (default 256) and `park.maxPerUser` (default 8). Overflow returns the JIT 403 immediately.
- Worker calls CP `POST /internal/park` (worker mTLS) with {sub, agent, provider, scopes or grant request, method, host, path-without-query}; CP reuses or creates the pending authorization from p3-connect-links, sends the notification, and returns {authorization_id, status_url}.
- New package internal/park: `Waiter.Wait(ctx, statusURL, deadline)` long-polls `GET /connect/{id}/status?wait=` until completed, denied or deadline. Effective deadline = min(maxWait, client hint `X-Warden-Max-Wait`, global cap).
- On completion the worker invalidates the per-user token cache entry and re-runs the secret swap stage, then forwards. The request body stays in memory (already bounded by maxBodySwapSize) and is never persisted.
- Client-gone safety: a watcher on the client conn aborts the park when the client closes; the request is never forwarded after abort. Metrics `warden_park_total{outcome}` (resumed|timeout|denied|client_gone|overflow) and `warden_park_wait_seconds`.

## Done when

With park enabled, a request missing a grant is held, the user gets a Slack/email link, and completing the flow within maxWait lets the original request succeed; otherwise the agent receives the JIT 403.

### 1/6 · W-P4-PARK-01

**Add park settings to agent config and wire type**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#222](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/222)

Add `Park` config (`enabled`, `maxWait`, `notify`) per agent in internal/config with raw YAML mapping and validation (maxWait <= 60s), plus worker-level `maxConcurrent` and `maxPerUser`. Mirror it in `SettingsWire` so the CP distributes it and the applier hot-reloads it.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] maxWait above 60s fails validation
- [ ] Settings round-trip through the wire type
- [ ] Default is disabled

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-PARK-02`](park-notify.md#26--w-p4-park-02) Add CP park endpoint that notifies the user; [`W-P4-PARK-03`](park-notify.md#36--w-p4-park-03) Add park waiter with concurrency limits

### 2/6 · W-P4-PARK-02

**Add CP park endpoint that notifies the user**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#223](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/223)

Add `POST /internal/park` in internal/controlplane, authenticated by worker cert. It finds an open pending authorization for (sub, provider/grant) or creates one via the connect-links code, sends a `park_pending` notification through internal/notify (deduped per authorization), and returns {authorization_id, status_url, authorize_url}. Request metadata stored is method, host, path without query.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Two parks for the same user and provider reuse one authorization
- [ ] Only one notification per authorization
- [ ] Worker without valid cert gets 401

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-PARK-01`](park-notify.md#16--w-p4-park-01) Add park settings to agent config and wire type; [`W-P4-NTFY-04`](user-notify.md#46--w-p4-ntfy-04) Add notify service with templates, dedup and rate limit

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-PARK-04`](park-notify.md#46--w-p4-park-04) Park and resume HTTP requests in the proxy pipeline

### 3/6 · W-P4-PARK-03

**Add park waiter with concurrency limits**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#224](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/224)

Create internal/park with `Waiter` (long-poll client over the status URL using the worker CP client), a global semaphore and per-sub counters. `Wait` returns Completed, Denied, Timeout or Canceled and respects ctx cancellation. Unit tests use a fake status server.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Returns Completed as soon as status flips
- [ ] Overflow beyond maxPerUser returns ErrOverflow without calling CP
- [ ] Ctx cancel returns Canceled promptly

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-PARK-01`](park-notify.md#16--w-p4-park-01) Add park settings to agent config and wire type

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-PARK-04`](park-notify.md#46--w-p4-park-04) Park and resume HTTP requests in the proxy pipeline

### 4/6 · W-P4-PARK-04

**Park and resume HTTP requests in the proxy pipeline**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#225](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/225)

In internal/proxy, where the JIT 403 is produced for a missing per-user grant or delegation grant, call the park path when enabled: POST /internal/park, then `Waiter.Wait` with the effective deadline. Start a client-conn watcher that cancels the wait on EOF. On Completed, invalidate the per-user token cache, re-run `swapSecrets` and continue to `forward`; on any other outcome write the existing JIT 403 JSON.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Completed within maxWait forwards the original request once
- [ ] Client disconnect during park does not forward upstream
- [ ] Timeout returns the JIT 403 body unchanged from Phase 3

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-PARK-02`](park-notify.md#26--w-p4-park-02) Add CP park endpoint that notifies the user; [`W-P4-PARK-03`](park-notify.md#36--w-p4-park-03) Add park waiter with concurrency limits

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-PARK-05`](park-notify.md#56--w-p4-park-05) Park MCP tool calls with progress notifications; [`W-P4-PARK-06`](park-notify.md#66--w-p4-park-06) Add park metrics, events and e2e test

### 5/6 · W-P4-PARK-05

**Park MCP tool calls with progress notifications**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#226](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/226)

Apply the same park path to MCP tools/call in the proxy and in the MCP gateway endpoint. When the client sent `_meta.progressToken` and the transport is SSE/Streamable HTTP, emit `notifications/progress` with a message containing the authorize URL while waiting. On timeout return the JSON-RPC tool error result from Phase 3.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Parked tools/call resumes and returns the upstream result
- [ ] Progress notification is emitted only when a progressToken exists
- [ ] Timeout returns the Phase 3 tool error fields

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-PARK-04`](park-notify.md#46--w-p4-park-04) Park and resume HTTP requests in the proxy pipeline; [`W-P4-MGW-06`](mcp-gateway.md#68--w-p4-mgw-06) Aggregate tools/list and route tools/call with verdicts

### 6/6 · W-P4-PARK-06

**Add park metrics, events and e2e test**

Type **test** · Size **S** · Issue [#227](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/227)

Add `warden_park_total{outcome}` and `warden_park_wait_seconds` in internal/observability and an analytics `Reason` value `parked_<outcome>`. Add an integration test: agent request without grant parks, a test user completes the connect flow via API, and the request succeeds.

**Acceptance criteria**
